description: Female participation in CzAO is around 40–50% in school rounds (54–55% in the last two years) but averages only 20–40% in national finals, with younger categories showing higher percentages of female finalists

description: CzAO school-round participation reached a stable base of 8–10k students annually for a decade, dropped to about 18% of the previous year during the Covid-19 pandemic, and is growing back above 7k per year
